result.summary: The page is mostly usable, but the bottom navigation area looks visually broken due to a dark bar/overlay crossing the tab icons. A few horizontally scrolling items are also clipped at the right edge, which is expected for carousels but looks slightly unfinished.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar appears overlapped by a thick black horizontal strip, and the search/cart icons look partially obscured or misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Check the tab bar height, safe-area insets, and any system gesture/navigation bar overlay so icons sit fully inside the tab bar without clipping.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the right edge and its restaurant name is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol...'.
issues.suggestion: If intentional, keep the peeking card but add clearer scroll affordance; otherwise adjust card width/spacing or allow the title to ellipsize cleanly within the visible area.

issues.description: Search placeholder text is light gray on a light gray field and may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase placeholder contrast slightly while keeping it visually distinct from entered text.
